sources: https://yatesfamilycamping.com/ (Cloudflare block to plain HTTP, WebFetch 403 and a headless browser, 2026-10-22)

hookups.source: No operator page exists: yatesfamilycamping.com became an unrelated 'Storybuilt' architecture page by October 2025 (Wayback 2025-10-04 to 2025-10-14), answered 404 in February 2026 and now sits behind a Cloudflare block; its last campground snapshot (January 2025) is a 2009-2014 race-camping blog with no hookup details. The stored water/sewer were derived from note prose resting on directory listings, so they are cleared.

sites.source: Same as hookups: the ~50-site count rests only on directory listings (RV Life lists 44); no operator page exists (read 2026-10-22).

facilities.source: Same as hookups: the dump station rests only on directory listings; no operator page exists (read 2026-10-22).

note: Family-owned campground at 6285 Hudspeth Rd, Harrisburg (Cabarrus Co), beside Charlotte Motor Speedway's race lots. Directory listings (not the operator) describe about 50 sites, half full hookup and half water/electric, and a dump station. Its old website is gone (an unrelated page in October 2025, 404 since); Google lists it at 4.6 over 119 reviews (October 2026). --Claude
summary: No live operator page: yatesfamilycamping.com was taken over by an unrelated 'Storybuilt' page in Oct 2025 and has been 404/blocked since; the last campground version (Jan 2025 Wayback) was a 2009-2014 race-camping blog saying 'Call (704)773-9349 for Reservations', with no rates. Google Maps still lists 'Yates family camping' (4.6, 119 reviews, 'Contact this property for rates', not marked closed), which meets the presence path. Cleared aggregator-only water/sewer, site count and dump; note cleaned (RV Life line is in rating). No 2024+ rate; price only RV Life's $$ tier.
flags: Dead/repurposed website: yatesfamilycamping.com showed an unrelated 'Storybuilt' design-collective page from October 2025 (Wayback), returned 404 by February 2026 and now blocks every reader behind Cloudflare. Google Maps still links that domain. Remove or replace the website; no other operator page found.

Presence: Google Maps 'Yates family camping', 6285 Hudspeth Rd, 4.6 stars over 119 reviews, 'Contact this property for rates and availability', not marked closed; the entry's phone 704-773-9349 matches the old site ('Call (704)773-9349 for Reservations'). Price only from the RV Life $$ tier (RV Life avg rate $25); no 2024+ operator rate and no booking engine.

Character: the old site was built around race-week camping (Coca-Cola 600, All-Star, NASCAR Banking 500, zMax Dragway reservations) plus a 'Peaceful Camping' page; whether nightly camping is sold outside race weeks, and any long-stay share, could not be checked with the site gone. Base on RV Life's tier is under the gate; Charlotte metro gateway 19 km in any case.
